ten_second.practical_choice: The House decided whether to accept revised instructions for committees to write later legislation on taxes, spending, deficits, and the debt limit.

thirty_second.prior_baseline: The House had approved an earlier version in February, but both chambers had not yet agreed on one framework.
thirty_second.mechanism: The revised resolution set an internal ten-year budget framework, directed committees to draft a later bill, and allowed that bill to use an expedited Senate process.

two_minute.detail: The framework included a Ways and Means parameter of up to $4.5 trillion in deficit increase, adjusted against whether specified committees reached at least $2 trillion in net deficit reduction over ten years. Those figures were drafting parameters, not direct effects or forecasts. A concurrent budget resolution governs Congress's internal process and is not presented to the President.
